svg.text: PikasekoHash-256: one step, one group of four registers
^ C[t mod 4] in the group of r0
All keys come from the state before the step. rot = rot1 (blocks move by one) on even t, rot2 on odd t;
the rotated key is the only data movement between the four 128-bit blocks of a register.
Groups by t mod 4 (stride s, cross offset c). Registers 0..15; one colour per group.
Bold outline: feed registers r0, r5, r10, r15 (each in a different group at every stride).
